instruction_ref: CEO explicit approval 2026-11-14: それでやって。
instruction: 5つのQAを維持。意味・比較QAから文章品質・結び・推薦文・独立ClaimQAとの重複判定を外し、編集企画書QAをCEO・企画固有の指示反映確認に限定。機械QA、編集QA、ClaimQA、ProductQA、CEOレビューは変更しない。
preserved_rules: Product QA still verifies independent product identities and comparison viability
Editorial QA still checks writing quality, reader guidance, conclusion and natural Japanese
Claim QA still checks all product factual statements against evidence
Machine QA, existing editor brief, CEO review and publication gates unchanged
CEO and topic-specific directions still receive independent plan checks and verifiable failure receipts
